standard-dialogue.player: Is it true a level 3 skiller caught one of your siblings?

standard-dialogue.npc: Yes, they killed my mummy, kidnapped my brother, smiled about it and went to sleep.

standard-dialogue.player: Aww, well you have me now! I shall call you Squishy and you shall be mine and you shall be my Squishy.
Come on, Squishy come on, little Squishy!
